_comment: sim-place-verify-rest-tolerance-v1 (coldwin85). Purpose: make the carton's REST POSE after the collect cart set-down DETERMINISTIC so the collect PLACE verify no longer fails with the carton 1 m off the shelf. coldwin85 was an EXACT re-run of coldwin83: both set the carton down and released it, finished the long retreat, then verify fired. cw83 PASSED (carton resting on the shelf, world z=1.022, stable); cw85 FAILED -- HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=verify 'place verification failed: carton not resting on deck (xy=1.219 bottom_gap=-0.954)' (host-stack.log line 40258): the carton had come to rest ~1 m below the shelf, ON THE FLOOR. nav-trace (RESTOCK_TRACE_POSES) proves the cart AND base did NOT move in either run (cart (-4.598,15.986) identical at release and verify), so the verify frame is correct -- the carton genuinely left the shelf.
_root_cause: The contact-gated release's STALL trigger fired on the DESCENT START height, ~0.06 m ABOVE the planned set-down, in BOTH runs. The render-paced descent trajectory had not produced motion yet, so the measured carton centre z (sensors.placed_pose) was FROZEN at the standoff for the first few ticks; the 'no downward progress for place_release_stall_ticks' rule read that startup freeze as 'support met' and released the weld too high. cw85 PLACE_RELEASE_TICK: carton_z FROZEN 0.6251 for 3 ticks (now 245.250 -> 245.517), stall=5 -> release trigger=stall, while PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_ARM computed 'release at carton_z<=0.5628' (0.0623 m lower). cw83 identical: frozen 0.6256, release_z 0.5635. Released 0.06 m high and still cradled in the side grip, whether the carton slips free onto the shelf (cw83: dropped 0.125 m, settled, verify passed) or stays perched and is carried off by the retreat fold (cw85: rode up to world z=1.77 as the arm folded, then fell to the floor z=0.08) is a coin flip -- the rest is non-deterministic. The place drive / support / gains were IDENTICAL; the differentiator was post-release luck.
_fix: A descent STALL only counts as 'support met' when the carton centre z is within release_z + place_release_stall_height_margin_m of the planned set-down. The render-paced STARTUP stall ~0.06 m HIGH is suppressed, the descent keeps pressing to the true set-down, and the weld releases on the z / effort / support-contact trigger where the carton actually rests on the shelf -- deterministic in both runs. Never touches the 2.0 deg carton tilt bound and never makes verify pass a carton that is not resting on the support (it makes the carton actually rest; the verify gate is UNCHANGED).
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> TransferController). The key below lives UNDER the existing carton_level block (parsed by carton_level.resolve_level_config, validated by LevelConfig.validate -- a bad value fails loudly at boot; no new config_preflight registration). This change only HARDENS the stall trigger of the already-on contact-gated release; keep the run's existing carton_level keys.

carton_level._existing: Keep the run's existing carton_level keys (place_release_on_contact:true / place_contact_release, place_contact_gap_m, closed_loop_*, place_from_above, release_cancel_handshake:true, release_reissue:true from PR 372, place_release_stall_m / place_release_stall_ticks, etc). Only the single key below is added by this change.
carton_level._place_release_stall_height_margin_m_not: Metres. A descent STALL (place_release.PlaceReleaseGate) counts as 'support met' ONLY when the measured carton centre z is <= release_z + this. release_z is the PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_ARM set-down height (cw85 0.5628, cw83 0.5635); the startup stall at carton_z 0.625 is 0.062 m above it, so with margin 0.02 (window top 0.583) it is SUPPRESSED -- the gate stays 'press' until the descent reaches the set-down, where the z trigger (carton_z <= release_z) fires the release at the TRUE contact. 0.02 m is well under the 0.062 m startup gap (so the premature stall is always suppressed) and comfortably ABOVE any real set-down jitter (so a genuine support-contact stall just above release_z still fires). None/absent => the stall trigger is unchanged => byte-identical (reproduces the cw85 dice roll). Inert when release_z is None (the place_contact_release / place_release_on_contact path always computes it).

_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the cw85 config (the full cold restock cycle through the collect cart set-down + retreat + verify) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with place_release_stall_height_margin_m:0.02 merged into the HOST carton_level block. Expected PASS (coldwin86-class): the welded carton descends level toward the shelf; the PLACE_RELEASE_TICK log now shows the carton_z DESCENDING past 0.6251 (not frozen+released) -- the startup stall is suppressed (stall counts but action stays press) -- and the release fires at carton_z<=release_z (trigger=z, ~0.563) where the carton sets DOWN on the shelf; the retreat lifts off a carton already at rest (world z ~1.02, not cradled high), and the collect verify reads xy within RESTOCK_PLACE_VERIFY_XY_TOL (0.25) and |bottom_gap| within RESTOCK_PLACE_VERIFY_Z_TOL (0.12) of the support top -- 'place verification' PASSES. If the descent genuinely cannot reach the set-down (a real obstruction), the effort trigger / obstruction gate still fires as before; the margin only suppresses the STARTUP stall, never a real contact.
